action.public_message: I'll use my Get Out of Jail Free card to get out.
action.private_thought: I own the orange monopoly and need to start building houses. Using the Get Out of Jail Free card preserves cash for purchases and avoids the risk of staying in jail another turn. Paying fine is also fine, but the card is a free resource now.

breakdown.message: Uses the jail card when card value beats paying cash or waiting.
